generate_sentences: create a HolisticBiasSentenceGenerator to generate templated sentences with metadata from the HolisticBias dataset
get_compiled_noun_phrases: build a dataframe of all noun phrases by combining descriptors and nouns from the dataset
get_sentence: retrieve a randomly selected sentence with stylistic variations like lowercase and hyphen removal
get_descriptors: load all descriptors from the HolisticBias dataset JSON file for a given dataset version
get_sentence_templates: load all sentence templates from the HolisticBias dataset JSON file for a given dataset version
